sources.title: Kennen Build Guide: Kennen top/mid - 600k points emerald insights

passive.name: Mark of the Storm
passive.text: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

spells.name: Thundering Shuriken
spells.text: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.

spells.name: Electrical Surge
spells.text: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.

spells.name: Lightning Rush
spells.text: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.

spells.name: Slicing Maelstrom
spells.text: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

damage.value: Kennen deals burst damage with mage items.

archetype.value: Kennen is a mobile mage who bullies lane and excels in teamfights.

axis.value: Kennen pokes to deny farm, then looks for an all-in when the target is low.

winCondition.value: Kennen wins by denying farm in lane, then flanking the backline around objectives.

spikes.why: Kennen can trade with Q, a fifth attack, and W to stun and trigger Electrocute.
Kennen can use R to dive a low-health target.
Kennen starts maxing E, gaining attack speed that improves splitpushing.

mistakes.value: Kennen wastes Electrical Surge's activation when no target is marked, since it damages targets who are already marked.
